name: The Alliance Needs More Rainbow Fin Albacore!

tooltip: "Seek out an Alliance Commendation Officer to exchange signets for recognition."

statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
What! You again? Well I'll be a monkey's uncle... except that I'm a gnome. Slicky Gastronome to be precise! So you're back to help out again eh? Well, I can't say as I blame you. Don't you just love the smell of all of that food? <drool>

Enough loitering! Get out there and bring me back more rainbow fin albacore!
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 rainbow fin albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I knew that you had it in you, kid. You've got the look of someone who knows what she likes. Specifically that you like pleasing me and the powers that be. And that you have, I guarantee.

Haha, ok, I'll just get these fish properly stashed away, and then you and I can have a little talk concerning you collecting another twenty albacore.
